Class LocationManager

java.lang.Object
simscli.game.LocationManager
public class LocationManager extends Object
Manages all game locations and world objects. Encapsulates location and object registry and travel logic.

  • Method Details

    • setGame

      public void setGame(Game game)
      Sets the Game instance for context-dependent operations. Must be called after LocationManager is created.
      Parameters:
      game - the Game instance

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Initializes all game locations and world objects. Call this once during game startup to register locations and objects.

    • getLocations

      public Map<String,Location> getLocations()
      Gets an unmodifiable map of all registered locations.
      Returns:
      immutable map of location keys to Location objects

    • getObjects

      public Map<String,Usable> getObjects()
      Gets an unmodifiable map of all registered world objects.
      Returns:
      immutable map of object keys to Usable objects

    • travelTo

      public String travelTo(Sim activeSim, String destinationKey)
      Handles traveling to a location. Applies movement costs and executes location entry actions.

    • performLocationAction

      public String performLocationAction(Sim activeSim, int actionIndex)
      Performs a location action for the active Sim. Retrieves the action at the given index from the current location and executes it through the Game context.
      Parameters:
      activeSim - the Sim performing the action
      actionIndex - the index of the action in the current location's action list
      Returns:
      a message describing the action result

    • useObject

      public String useObject(String objectKey)
      Uses a world object from the registry. Objects include furniture (bed, fridge, shower) that can be interacted with. Executes the object's action through the Game context.
      Parameters:
      objectKey - the identifier of the object to use
      Returns:
      a message describing the object interaction result
